long_biography.plain_text:
Lubritrade began in 1986 as an engineering-lubricants trader. Under Lim's leadership, the company shifted towards alcohol and tobacco, launched proprietary brands, built a Singapore distribution arm and expanded into Thailand. The group later added printing and warehousing capabilities, while developing hospitality, food and beverage, construction and property interests.

Lim has paired that operating career with sustained support for higher education. He established a S$1 million scholarship at Singapore Management University, funding twenty-five full, bond-free undergraduate awards over five years. He subsequently endowed a bursary there for underprivileged students. A separate gift created one of the Singapore Institute of Technology's first endowed scholarships, supporting talented Singaporean students in financial need.
